---
title: "Precinct & County Comparisons"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(DT)
library(scales)

# Disable s2 spherical geometry warnings for county union operations
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# 1. Load county datasets
ca_raw <- read_csv("data/california/results_county_2024.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
fl_raw <- read_csv("data/florida/results_county_2024.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
ind_raw <- read_csv("data/indiana/results_county_2024.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
nc_2026_raw <- read_tsv("data/north_carolina/results_pct_20261103.txt", show_col_types = FALSE, quote = "")

# 2. Build spatial datasets for California, Florida, and Indiana
build_state_sf <- \(state_name, df_raw) {
  geo <- st_as_sf(maps::map("county", state_name, plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE)) |>
    st_make_valid() |>
    mutate(county_clean = gsub("[^a-z]", "", tolower(gsub(":.*$", "", gsub(paste0("^", state_name, ","), "", ID))))) |>
    group_by(county_clean) |>
    summarise(geometry = suppressMessages(st_union(geom)), .groups = "drop")
    
  df_raw |>
    mutate(
      county_clean = gsub("[^a-z]", "", tolower(gsub(" County$", "", county_name))),
      dem_margin = 100 * (votes_dem - votes_gop) / total_votes,
      vote_diff = abs(votes_dem - votes_gop),
      pct_margin = abs(dem_margin),
      winner = if_else(votes_dem > votes_gop, "Kamala Harris (DEM)", "Donald Trump (REP)"),
      popup_html = paste0(
        "<strong>", county_name, "</strong><br>",
        "<hr style='margin:4px 0;'>",
        "Winner: <strong>", winner, "</strong><br>",
        "Democrat: <strong>", scales::comma(votes_dem), "</strong> (", sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * votes_dem / total_votes), ")<br>",
        "Republican: <strong>", scales::comma(votes_gop), "</strong> (", sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * votes_gop / total_votes), ")<br>",
        "Margin: <strong>", if_else(dem_margin >= 0, "+", ""), sprintf("%.2f%%", dem_margin),
        " (", scales::comma(vote_diff), " votes)</strong><br>",
        "Total Turnout: <strong>", scales::comma(total_votes), "</strong>"
      ),
      hover_label = paste0(
        county_name, ": ",
        if_else(dem_margin >= 0, paste0("DEM +", sprintf("%.1f%%", dem_margin)), paste0("REP +", sprintf("%.1f%%", -dem_margin))),
        " (", scales::comma(total_votes), " votes)"
      )
    ) |>
    inner_join(geo, by = "county_clean") |>
    st_as_sf() |>
    st_transform(4326)
}

ca_sf <- build_state_sf("california", ca_raw)
fl_sf <- build_state_sf("florida", fl_raw)
ind_sf <- build_state_sf("indiana", ind_raw)

# 3. North Carolina Precinct Boundaries & Results
precincts_sf <- st_read(
  "/vsizip/data/north_carolina/SBE_PRECINCTS_20260824.zip/SBE_PRECINCTS_20260824.shp",
  quiet = TRUE
)

nc_precinct_margins <- nc_2026_raw |>
  filter(
    `Contest Name` == "US SENATE",
    `Real Precinct` == "Y",
    `Choice Party` %in% c("DEM", "REP")
  ) |>
  group_by(County, Precinct, `Choice Party`) |>
  summarise(votes = sum(`Total Votes`), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = `Choice Party`, values_from = votes, values_fill = 0) |>
  filter(DEM + REP > 0) |>
  mutate(
    total_two_party = DEM + REP,
    vote_diff = abs(DEM - REP),
    pct_margin = 100 * vote_diff / total_two_party,
    dem_margin = 100 * (DEM - REP) / total_two_party,
    winner = factor(
      case_when(
        DEM == REP ~ "Exact Tie",
        DEM > REP ~ "Roy Cooper (DEM)",
        TRUE ~ "Michael Whatley (REP)"
      ),
      levels = c("Exact Tie", "Roy Cooper (DEM)", "Michael Whatley (REP)")
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(pct_margin, vote_diff, desc(total_two_party)) |>
  mutate(rank = min_rank(pct_margin))

nc_top50_sf <- precincts_sf |>
  inner_join(
    nc_precinct_margins |> slice_head(n = 50),
    by = c("county_nam" = "County", "prec_id" = "Precinct")
  ) |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  arrange(pct_margin, vote_diff) |>
  mutate(
    precinct_label = if_else(
      enr_desc == prec_id,
      prec_id,
      paste0(prec_id, " — ", str_to_title(enr_desc))
    ),
    popup_html = paste0(
      "<strong>Rank #", rank, ": ", str_to_title(county_nam), " County</strong><br>",
      "Precinct: ", precinct_label, "<br><hr style='margin:4px 0;'>",
      "Roy Cooper (DEM): <strong>", scales::comma(DEM), "</strong><br>",
      "Michael Whatley (REP): <strong>", scales::comma(REP), "</strong><br>",
      "Margin: <strong>", vote_diff, if_else(vote_diff == 1, " vote", " votes"),
      sprintf(" (%.2f%%)", pct_margin), "</strong> — ", winner
    ),
    hover_label = paste0(
      "#", rank, " ", str_to_title(county_nam), " (", prec_id, "): ",
      if_else(vote_diff == 0, "Exact Tie!", paste0(winner, " +", vote_diff, " (", sprintf("%.2f%%", pct_margin), ")"))
    )
  )

# Color palettes
margin_pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = c("#b2182b", "#ef8a62", "#f7f7f7", "#67a9cf", "#2166ac"),
  domain = c(-60, 60),
  na.color = "#cccccc"
)

winner_pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("#7c3aed", "#1d68c4", "#d73027"),
  levels = c("Exact Tie", "Roy Cooper (DEM)", "Michael Whatley (REP)")
)

# Helper function to render county-level choropleth
render_county_map <- \(sf_data) {
  leaflet(sf_data, height = 520, width = "100%") |>
    addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldGrayCanvas) |>
    addPolygons(
      fillColor = ~margin_pal(pmax(pmin(dem_margin, 60), -60)),
      fillOpacity = 0.78,
      weight = 1.2,
      color = "#ffffff",
      dashArray = "1",
      highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
        weight = 2.5,
        color = "#111827",
        bringToFront = TRUE
      ),
      label = ~hover_label,
      popup = ~popup_html
    ) |>
    addLegend(
      position = "bottomright",
      pal = margin_pal,
      values = c(-60, 60),
      title = "Dem Margin (%)",
      labFormat = labelFormat(suffix = "%", transform = \(x) x),
      opacity = 0.85
    )
}

# Helper function for searchable data tables
render_comparison_table <- \(df) {
  datatable(
    df,
    extensions = "Buttons",
    options = list(
      dom = "Bfrtip",
      buttons = list(
        list(extend = "copy", text = "📋 Copy"),
        list(extend = "csv", text = "📥 Download CSV")
      ),
      pageLength = 8,
      autoWidth = TRUE
    ),
    rownames = FALSE
  ) |>
    formatRound(c("Dem Votes", "GOP Votes", "Total Votes"), digits = 0, mark = ",") |>
    formatRound("Margin (%)", digits = 2) |>
    formatStyle(
      "Margin (%)",
      backgroundColor = styleInterval(
        c(-30, -15, -0.01, 0, 15, 30),
        c("#fee2e2", "#fecaca", "#fee2e2", "#f8fafc", "#e0e7ff", "#bfdbfe", "#93c5fd")
      ),
      color = styleInterval(0, c("#991b1b", "#1e40af")),
      fontWeight = "600"
    )
}
```

Explore geographic election breakdowns across different states. Select a tab below to switch between **California**, **North Carolina**, **Florida**, and **Indiana** to inspect voting districts, victory margins, and competitive areas.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## 🐻 California

Interactive choropleth map of California's 58 counties from the 2024 Presidential election. Hover or click any county to view vote totals and victory margins:

```{r}
#| label: ca-precinct-map
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

render_county_map(ca_sf)
```

### California County Results

```{r}
#| label: ca-table
#| echo: false

ca_table_df <- ca_sf |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  arrange(desc(total_votes)) |>
  transmute(
    `County` = county_name,
    `Winner` = winner,
    `Dem Votes` = votes_dem,
    `GOP Votes` = votes_gop,
    `Total Votes` = total_votes,
    `Margin (%)` = dem_margin
  )

render_comparison_table(ca_table_df)
```

## 🌲 North Carolina

Interactive precinct-level voting map showing the **top 50 closest voting precincts** across North Carolina in the 2026 U.S. Senate race between Roy Cooper (DEM) and Michael Whatley (REP). Two precincts ended in an exact tie, and two were decided by a single vote.

```{r}
#| label: nc-precincts-map
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

leaflet(nc_top50_sf, height = 520, width = "100%") |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldGrayCanvas) |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~winner_pal(winner),
    fillOpacity = 0.85,
    weight = 2,
    color = "#ffffff",
    dashArray = "1",
    label = ~hover_label,
    popup = ~popup_html,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 3.5,
      color = "#111827",
      bringToFront = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = st_centroid(nc_top50_sf),
    radius = 5,
    color = "#111827",
    weight = 1.5,
    fillColor = ~winner_pal(winner),
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    label = ~hover_label,
    popup = ~popup_html
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = winner_pal,
    values = ~winner,
    title = "Precinct Winner",
    opacity = 0.9
  )
```

### North Carolina Closest Precincts

```{r}
#| label: nc-table
#| echo: false

nc_table_df <- nc_precinct_margins |>
  slice_head(n = 50) |>
  transmute(
    `Precinct` = paste0(str_to_title(County), " — ", Precinct),
    `Winner` = as.character(winner),
    `Dem Votes` = DEM,
    `GOP Votes` = REP,
    `Total Votes` = total_two_party,
    `Margin (%)` = dem_margin
  )

render_comparison_table(nc_table_df)
```
